The attachment point is nearly invisible and doesn't catch hair or give way and break easily the way our Goody ones do.  I originally got them for my 4yo daughter's thick, long hair BECAUSE of the colors and I've found myself using them (despite the colors) instead of the black/brown ones I've used for years because these are so much better. reviews.t: It is Ok but I will not buy it next time
reviews.x: The hair bands are pretty good but a little too stretchy.So after a while, it becomes too loose and doesn't hold your hair for a very long time. Also, after using it for a few weeks, the inside rubber band starts to show and it starts to break. I would not buy it next time.

reviews.t: It came in handy for making my masks.
reviews.x: I like the color variation. Because of the shortage of elastic I used it to make masks.
Every color except black or white.... unexpected

reviews.t: You get what you pay for
reviews.x: I was looking for 4mm elastics for my daughter’s and my hair. Subject similar to the generic black ones we‘ve used for the past years and somehow misplace all the time. Loved the colors of this pack. They are 4mm but that‘s where the positive ends. The elastic is too stretchy. Our previous hair ties we would wrap 3-4x around. These needed 5-6x and after one wear they are stretched out. So pretty much single use hair ties :( As someone who is looking for eco friendly options and wants to reuse an

reviews.t: Stretch out until the elastic doesn't work.
reviews.x: I normally wouldn't leave a review for such a low priced product but these were SO disappointing that I have to leave one.  I thought some of the other reviews were exaggerating when they said the hands stretched out and were unusable but that's exactly what happened. If I try to stretch one to put it in my 6 year olds hair the elastic pills until just the material is holding it together. It went from 2 inches to 8 inches of non-elastic material. I was excited about the good variety of colors bu

reviews.t: Expect to throw some away when you get them. The rest marches the description.
reviews.x: The first ones I tried where dry and didn’t stretch or never came back to the original size. The rest is ok. So consider that 10-15 might have to be thrown away the first day. That’s why I gave it 3 stars. The others are good and worked as expected and seems like good quality and matching the description.

reviews.t: Buy these!! Good quality at a low cost!
reviews.x: I’m a male growing my hair out to donate it so didn’t know the struggle was real with longer hair! Girls, you have my sympathy with the “should I put it up” dilemma!! These things are great! I have hen lying around EVERYWHERE lol and they aren’t cheaply made and take a beating...err stretching

The first five or six snapped on one loop. Several more stretch out and lost all elasticity on the first stretch. As I go though the bag, the same thing continues. Lost count at this point. Pure garbage. Not worth the hassle to return.  Do yourself a favor and buy elsewhere.

reviews.t: Exactly what I ordered: so colorful!
reviews.x: Colors, material, elasticity, and size are all exactly what was represented and the price was great. I'm a grandma with long hair so I'll be using these, but I'm sharing half of them with my daughter and granddaughter. Thank you.

reviews.t: a little too stretchy - but love the variety of color!
reviews.x: love all of the colors, but i wish they didn’t stretch out so much after one use. my elastic is huge now after using one pony tail so it falls off my wrist - but there is plenty in the bag! i hope this helps!

reviews.t: Long lasting stretch and no pinch like regular elastic bands.
reviews.x: I like the durability of these elastics.  I cut them open so they’d be long enough to reach people’s ears. I and glued the ends to make homemade pandemic masks.  Fun colors  Especially for This purpose.
These stretch way out of shape; lose elasticity quickly. The first time use is not bad, but after that I have to wrap my hair so many times it’s ridiculous. I am so disappointed with this purchase.
Very unhappy customer. The bag was opened upon opening Amazon box.  The bands were all over the box. The worst part is that i only received 50 bands as the other half are missing!!!!????
Terrible product. Didn’t even get them in my daughters hair and they were stretched out three times the size. Seems like they used old elastic when making them. Extremely disappointed
Used these to make face mask required during the Covid-19 pandemic. The vibrant colors matched well with various fabrics. Only a few snapped while testing for comfort
Great colors and they're much more durable than I would have thought for the money. They keep my kiddo's hair in place (less flyaways than other bands), too.
The bands were either hard as rocks or “stretched” to 5 inches at the slightest tug - and completely lost its form. Don’t waste your time or money
Got it as a gift for teens at camp.....love color selection and how many......did not return to unstretch size.....but didn't break either
These are very stretchy and soft hair ties but they are a one time use. If you wrap them three times around your hair they over stretch.
These are good quality. I love that they came in so many different colors. Let’s see how long it takes for me to lose them all hahaha 😂

claims.text: Several reviewers report receiving fewer hair ties than the advertised 100, with only 72 in the pack.
Many reviewers complain the elastics are too stretchy, stretch out after use, or lose elasticity and break.
Reviewers frequently praise the wide variety of colors in the pack.
Some reviewers note quality issues such as a diesel fuel smell or having to throw away dry, unusable ties.
Multiple reviewers describe the product as good quality and great value for the low price.
